title: Taihang Mountains
summary: The Taihang Mountains is a large mountain range located in China. There is a temple, which is home to Master Storm and his granddaughter, Lin Storm.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale stayed some time at the temple when he was a teenager, where he trained everyday with Lin Storm.

Troubled by Arc's vision of his death, Dante returned many years later to train in secret and prepare for his fate. Master Storm taught him the power Copykind, which Dante used soon enough to copy Ignatius' powers after teleporting away with Umbra to help his team at the Castle of Vlad Dracul. [Lok's Leadership]
